prompts.comment: The fixed prompt set of scripts/measure-tools.mts (#513). Placeholders: {project} this project's name, {other} the other project's name, {seed} the seeded session's name. A run's JSON keeps the prompts it used; change this file and the two runs no longer compare.
prompts.seed: Note for later, no action needed: for the database backup we decided on pg_dump, nightly at 03:00. Reply with the single word OK.

selection.prompt: What are the other sessions in this project working on right now?
In an earlier conversation we decided how to back up the database. What did we choose?
How do I let my other Centralu projects use an app from this project?
Have the {other} project list the files in its top folder, then tell me what it found.
One of my other Centralu projects shares a counter app. What number is it showing now?
What is 17 times 23? Answer with the number only.
Which sessions are there in {project}, and what is each one doing?
Ask the session "{seed}" to reply with the single word DONE.
